verdict.rationale: Postman collections are technically JSON-based and can be exported/backed up (postman-comm-14, postman-comm-16), and the Postman API allows programmatic asset management (postman-docs-5), but numerous community reports describe forced cloud account requirements, data wiped on declining login, and friction migrating data away from Postman's cloud (postman-comm-13, postman-comm-15, postman-comm-17), directly contradicting a smooth 'export everything and leave' experience.
